description: Ranked candidates with stable locators, and the attention reasons that make this source worth shipping. The first query names a project by name, which is an exact identifier hit and partitions above every lexical one; hnbooks arrives carrying three classifications and every recorded reason behind them — dormant on its own would be noise, and 'dormant, no commits in 164 days, but 137 stars and an open external PR' is a decision. The second is a structured request for one project. The third has no query terms at all: a browse of the catalog in its own default order, most recent commit first, whose candidates carry the field match signal rather than a lexical one, and where atlas — never scanned, so its commit date is unknown rather than old — sorts below the projects whose dates are known. The fourth adds a time window over the only date a project has. Locators are the catalog's own project ids, which ongoing derives from the repository's canonical path and the daily rescan leaves alone.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
